note: The versions CI actually runs. `minimum` is what the project still supports; `verified` is what the ubuntu-24.04 runner ships and what .devcontainer/Dockerfile installs. check_toolchain.py fails when a tool that is present on the host is older than its minimum, and skips tools that are absent (a host job has no ARM toolchain).
why_clang_format_is_special: clang-format changes its output between major versions. Formatting a tree with 14 and checking it with 18 produces failures that are not real. Keep the local major version equal to CI's.
